source: Santa Catalina Island terrain mesh (Sketchfab download, Blender export) + Esri World Imagery texture
notes: x=east, y=up, z=south; origin at island centroid at sea level. Heights: 65x65 source grid, bicubic-smoothed, coastline refined from the aerial imagery land mask, faint canyon relief from high-passed imagery luminance. Sea points have y=0, density decaying ~3.6 km offshore. Colours: true aerial RGB. s byte = uniform random. Pre-shuffled.
